question: Who among the following won the 2025 Pritzker Architecture Prize awarded in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Liu Jiakun**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Liu Jiakun** is a renowned Chinese architect celebrated for his unique architectural style that blends modernism with traditional Chinese aesthetics.
 
• He was awarded the **2025 Pritzker Architecture Prize**, often regarded as the "Nobel Prize of Architecture," in **May 2025**.
 
• The **Pritzker Prize** recognizes architects who have made significant contributions to humanity through the art of architecture.
 
• **Liu Jiakun's** work is widely acclaimed for its focus on **sustainability**, cultural preservation, and community integration.
 
• One of his notable projects includes the **Luodai Museum of Hakka Culture** in China, which showcases his ability to harmonize modern architecture with local traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pritzker Architecture Prize:**

 
 
• Established in **1979** by the Pritzker family of Chicago to honor architects whose work demonstrates talent, vision, and commitment.
 
• Previous winners include **Jean Nouvel** (2008), **Zaha Hadid** (2004), and **David Chipperfield** (2023).
 
• The award includes a cash prize of **$100,000** and a bronze medallion.
 
 
 
• **Liu Jiakun's Architectural Philosophy:**
 
 
• His designs focus on **human-centric architecture**, promoting harmony between the built environment and its inhabitants.
 
• He incorporates **local materials** and techniques, ensuring sustainability and cultural relevance.
 
 
 
• **Other Options:**
 
 
• **Jeanne Gang:** An American architect known for the Aqua Tower in Chicago. She has not won the 2025 Pritzker Prize.
 
• **Shigeru Ban:** A Japanese architect acclaimed for his work with paper and cardboard in disaster relief projects. He won the Pritzker Prize in **2014**.
 
• **David Chipperfield:** A British architect known for his minimalist designs. He won the Pritzker Prize in **2023**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Pritzker Prize:**
 
 
• The prize highlights the role of architecture in addressing global challenges, including urbanization, sustainability, and cultural preservation.
 
• It serves to inspire architects worldwide to pursue excellence and innovation in their work.
